tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

OpenSpec is authoritative for scope, requirements, workflow, artifacts, and task state.
Current schema: spec-driven.
Starting task progress: 0/17.

The GLLA task list is preloaded deterministically from the OpenSpec task list at goal creation.
It is a status mirror, not an independent planning source. Do not call propose_task_list merely to recreate the initial OpenSpec task breakdown.

Initial task mapping:
- GLLA 1 <- OpenSpec 1: [ ] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 2 <- OpenSpec 2: [ ] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3
- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green
- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [ ] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [ ] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 8 <- OpenSpec 8: [ ] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 9 <- OpenSpec 9: [ ] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 10 <- OpenSpec 10: [ ] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build
- GLLA 11 <- OpenSpec 11: [ ] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test
- GLLA 12 <- OpenSpec 12: [ ] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 13 <- OpenSpec 13: [ ] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 14 <- OpenSpec 14: [ ] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`
- GLLA 15 <- OpenSpec 15: [ ] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
- GLLA 16 <- OpenSpec 16: [ ] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests
- GLLA 17 <- OpenSpec 17: [ ] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

Use the installed OpenSpec apply workflow/skill as the implementation procedure.

At the start of work, after every context compaction, after every resume, and whenever task state is uncertain:

1. Run:
   openspec status --change "fix-xtb-session-editing" --json

2. Run:
   openspec instructions apply --change "fix-xtb-session-editing" --json

3. Treat the returned OpenSpec state, instruction, tasks, context, operationGuidance, and contextFiles as authoritative.

4. Read all contextFiles relevant to the remaining work before modifying code.

Resume from the first genuinely incomplete task. Do not redo completed work unnecessarily.

Implement every remaining required task.

GLLA task-list synchronization is a hard, per-task requirement, using GLLA's own task tools (not prose):

- GLLA task id N mirrors exactly one OpenSpec task; its title prefix "[OpenSpec <task-id>]" names that OpenSpec task.
- When you START a mirrored OpenSpec task, call update_task_status with that GLLA id and status "in_progress".
- In the SAME turn where you legitimately flip an OpenSpec checkbox to "- [x]" (or otherwise complete that OpenSpec task), call complete_task with the corresponding GLLA id. One OpenSpec checkbox flip = one complete_task call. Never batch all syncs to the end of the session.
- When several mirrored tasks genuinely finish in one turn, one update_task_batch call is also acceptable.
- GLLA's pending-task gate REFUSES complete_goal while any mirrored GLLA task is still open — a stale mirror blocks goal completion even when OpenSpec itself is finished.
- Never mark either side complete merely because work was attempted.
- The bridge extension also mirrors OpenSpec completions into the GLLA list at turn boundaries as a safety net, but do not rely on it; keep the mirror correct yourself.

If the authoritative OpenSpec task set itself changes after attachment, do not silently ignore the difference or invent an independent plan. Reconcile against a fresh OpenSpec apply response before completion.

Run relevant builds, focused tests, integration tests, and regression checks as work progresses. Fix failures caused by this change rather than bypassing them.

Do not weaken, delete, rewrite, reinterpret, or silently defer OpenSpec requirements merely to make implementation easier.

Do not switch to a different OpenSpec change.

If OpenSpec reports state="blocked", resolve the missing required planning artifact through the OpenSpec workflow before continuing implementation. Do not invent missing requirements merely to get past the block.

If OpenSpec reports state="all_done", do not immediately declare success. Perform the final verification below first.

Before claiming completion, independently re-read:

- the current OpenSpec status;
- the current OpenSpec apply instructions;
- all relevant OpenSpec artifacts;
- the repository diff and working-tree state;
- the actual build/test/regression outputs.
goal.verificationContract:
1. "openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-session-editing --json" reports zero remaining required implementation tasks.

2. Every explicit requirement and scenario in the active OpenSpec change has corresponding implementation evidence.

3. OpenSpec task completion accurately reflects the actual codebase state; no checkbox is marked complete merely because work was attempted.

4. Relevant builds, tests, and regression checks pass.

5. No known required work, implementation blocker, knowingly failing relevant test, or silently deferred required task remains.

6. A final comparison of the OpenSpec artifacts against the resulting implementation finds no substantive omission.

Do not declare the GLLA goal complete based only on previous conversation claims or task checkboxes. Verify against current repository and OpenSpec evidence.

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

OpenSpec is authoritative for scope, requirements, workflow, artifacts, and task state.
Current schema: spec-driven.
Starting task progress: 0/17.

The GLLA task list is preloaded deterministically from the OpenSpec task list at goal creation.
It is a status mirror, not an independent planning source. Do not call propose_task_list merely to recreate the initial OpenSpec task breakdown.

Initial task mapping:
- GLLA 1 <- OpenSpec 1: [ ] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 2 <- OpenSpec 2: [ ] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3
- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green
- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [ ] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [ ] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 8 <- OpenSpec 8: [ ] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 9 <- OpenSpec 9: [ ] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 10 <- OpenSpec 10: [ ] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build
- GLLA 11 <- OpenSpec 11: [ ] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test
- GLLA 12 <- OpenSpec 12: [ ] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 13 <- OpenSpec 13: [ ] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 14 <- OpenSpec 14: [ ] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`
- GLLA 15 <- OpenSpec 15: [ ] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
- GLLA 16 <- OpenSpec 16: [ ] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests
- GLLA 17 <- OpenSpec 17: [ ] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

Use the installed OpenSpec apply workflow/skill as the implementation procedure.

At the start of work, after every context compaction, after every resume, and whenever task state is uncertain:

1. Run:
   openspec status --change "fix-xtb-session-editing" --json

2. Run:
   openspec instructions apply --change "fix-xtb-session-editing" --json

3. Treat the returned OpenSpec state, instruction, tasks, context, operationGuidance, and contextFiles as authoritative.

4. Read all contextFiles relevant to the remaining work before modifying code.

Resume from the first genuinely incomplete task. Do not redo completed work unnecessarily.

Implement every remaining required task.

GLLA task-list synchronization is a hard, per-task requirement, using GLLA's own task tools (not prose):

- GLLA task id N mirrors exactly one OpenSpec task; its title prefix "[OpenSpec <task-id>]" names that OpenSpec task.
- When you START a mirrored OpenSpec task, call update_task_status with that GLLA id and status "in_progress".
- In the SAME turn where you legitimately flip an OpenSpec checkbox to "- [x]" (or otherwise complete that OpenSpec task), call complete_task with the corresponding GLLA id. One OpenSpec checkbox flip = one complete_task call. Never batch all syncs to the end of the session.
- When several mirrored tasks genuinely finish in one turn, one update_task_batch call is also acceptable.
- GLLA's pending-task gate REFUSES complete_goal while any mirrored GLLA task is still open — a stale mirror blocks goal completion even when OpenSpec itself is finished.
- Never mark either side complete merely because work was attempted.
- The bridge extension also mirrors OpenSpec completions into the GLLA list at turn boundaries as a safety net, but do not rely on it; keep the mirror correct yourself.

If the authoritative OpenSpec task set itself changes after attachment, do not silently ignore the difference or invent an independent plan. Reconcile against a fresh OpenSpec apply response before completion.

Run relevant builds, focused tests, integration tests, and regression checks as work progresses. Fix failures caused by this change rather than bypassing them.

Do not weaken, delete, rewrite, reinterpret, or silently defer OpenSpec requirements merely to make implementation easier.

Do not switch to a different OpenSpec change.

If OpenSpec reports state="blocked", resolve the missing required planning artifact through the OpenSpec workflow before continuing implementation. Do not invent missing requirements merely to get past the block.

If OpenSpec reports state="all_done", do not immediately declare success. Perform the final verification below first.

Before claiming completion, independently re-read:

- the current OpenSpec status;
- the current OpenSpec apply instructions;
- all relevant OpenSpec artifacts;
- the repository diff and working-tree state;
- the actual build/test/regression outputs.
goal.verificationContract:
1. "openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-session-editing --json" reports zero remaining required implementation tasks.

2. Every explicit requirement and scenario in the active OpenSpec change has corresponding implementation evidence.

3. OpenSpec task completion accurately reflects the actual codebase state; no checkbox is marked complete merely because work was attempted.

4. Relevant builds, tests, and regression checks pass.

5. No known required work, implementation blocker, knowingly failing relevant test, or silently deferred required task remains.

6. A final comparison of the OpenSpec artifacts against the resulting implementation finds no substantive omission.

Do not declare the GLLA goal complete based only on previous conversation claims or task checkboxes. Verify against current repository and OpenSpec evidence.

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests
